summary: Oncolytics Biotech Inc. filed an 8-K reporting alignment with the FDA on the design of a pivotal study for pelareorep in squamous cell carcinoma of the anal canal. The disclosure describes a Type C meeting outcome and plans for a randomized controlled trial potentially supporting accelerated and full approval. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation are mentioned. The filing is a routine clinical development update without any merger, acquisition, restructuring, or other special-situation event. As such, it does not fall into any special-situations category.
